trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.

steps.purpose: Customer reports an issue with their order delivery.
steps.text: Hello, నా order ORD-30004 కి courier వాడు address దొరకట్లేదు అని అంటున్నాడు. ఏమైంది?

steps.purpose: Retrieve order details.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_order to check the status of the order provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to check the order status and details to understand the current situation.

steps.purpose: Return order details.
Retrieve shipment tracking details.
steps.expected_behavior: Call track_shipment to get courier updates.
steps.planner_rationale: The order is shipped, so I need to check the courier's scan history and exceptions.

steps.purpose: Return shipment details.
Inform the user of the courier status and begin stating next steps.
steps.text: మీరు order చేసిన office chair COD order. Courier Delhivery వాళ్ళు address unreachable అని update చేసారు. Next steps కోసం నేను...

steps.purpose: Interrupt the agent to dispute the courier's claim.
steps.text: Address unreachable ఆ? నేను ఇంట్లోనే ఉన్నాను, ఎవరూ రాలేదు!

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the interruption, resume without repeating, and ask for verification to raise a complaint.
steps.text: అర్థం అయ్యింది. Already 5 days promised time దాటింది కాబట్టి, నేను not delivered పైన complaint raise చేస్తాను. దానికి ముందు మీ date of birth చెప్తారా?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth (with an STT error).
steps.text: నా date of birth May tenth.

steps.purpose: Verify identity using the provided date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Attempt to verify the user with the provided date of birth.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to call the verification tool with the date of birth factor to proceed with the complaint.

steps.purpose: Return verification failure.
Inform the user of verification failure and ask for an alternative factor.
steps.text: Sorry, అది match అవ్వలేదు. మీ registered pincode చెప్తారా?

steps.purpose: Provide registered pincode.
Verify identity using the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verification tool with the registered pincode.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to verify the customer's identity using the pincode they just provided.

steps.purpose: Return verification success.
Raise a delivery complaint.
steps.expected_behavior: Raise the complaint now that identity is verified and the promised window has elapsed.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer is verified and the delivery is past its promised window, so I am authorized to raise a not_delivered complaint.

steps.purpose: Return complaint details.
Inform the user that the complaint has been raised.
steps.text: మీ details verify అయ్యాయి. నేను complaint raise చేసాను, మీ complaint ID CMP-9988. ఇది 3 days లో resolve అవుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on domain terminology and repeat the ID to confirm.
steps.text: CMP-9988 కదా? ఈ 'resolve' అవుతుంది అంటే ఏంటి, 3 days time పడుతుందా? అప్పటి దాకా నేను ఏమి చేయాలి?

steps.purpose: Clarify the terminology and reassure the customer about the COD payment.
steps.text: అవునండి, CMP-9988. Resolve అవ్వడం అంటే మీ order మీకు ఎప్పుడు వస్తుంది అని 3 days లో clear గా చెప్తారు. ఇది COD order కాబట్టి మీరు ముందు pay చేయాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated. Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.
